plays.desc_ko: 리플레이 직후 라이브 화면으로 전환되며 LYON이 퇴각하는 HLE를 추격함. 인스파이어드의 꿰뚫기로 딜라이트와 제카를 묶고, 포위된 제우스까지 버서커가 마무리하며 HLE 전원을 에이스(Ace) 띄움.
plays.desc_en: Cutting back live from replay, LYON runs down the retreating HLE squad; Inspired locks down Delight and Zeka with Impale, while Berserker finishes off an isolated Zeus to wipe HLE for a clean Ace.
plays.quote: still a brilliant fight. AND THEY'RE ... LOOKING FOR GMA. WE'RE RIGHT BACK ON THE ... LINE, BUT GUMAUI'S DEAD. INSPIRED

plays.action: Base assault and first Nexus turret demolition with aborted end
plays.desc_ko: 에이스 이후 LYON이 미드 웨이브를 몰아 적 본진으로 돌진하여 첫 번째 넥서스 타워를 파괴했으나, 체력이 너무 낮고 딜라이트/구마유시 부활이 임박하자 끝내지 못하고 안전하게 후퇴함.
plays.desc_en: Following the Ace, LYON marches mid minions into HLE's base and destroys the first Nexus turret, but with low health bars and respawns looming, they wisely call off the end and retreat safely.
plays.quote: SHOULD BE ABLE TO END IT RIGHT HERE ... RIGHT NOW. THEY GOT THE WAVE. THEY'RE ... in 10. Lion health bars compromised.

plays.action: Dragon 4 Soul point contest and Saint steal with 4-kill turnaround
plays.desc_ko: HLE가 4번째 마법공학 영혼 용을 치던 중 LYON이 저지에 나섬. HLE가 버서커를 폭딜로 끊어냈으나, 도클라가 공간을 벌리고 세인트(빅토르)가 존야(Stasis)를 쓰며 용을 극적으로 스틸하고 제카를 처형하며 HLE 4명을 몰살시킴 (구마유시만 생존).
plays.desc_en: As HLE attempts the fourth dragon for Hextech Soul, LYON contests; HLE bursts down Berserker, but Dhokla creates space and Saint's Viktor activates Zhonya's to miraculously steal the dragon while executing Zeka, wiping four HLE members with only Gumayusi escaping.
plays.quote: Lion's going in. They want to try ... to challenge here for the Soul. This ... could decide the entire game. HLE

plays.action: Aborted end attempt following Dragon 4 turnaround
plays.title_ko: 용 한타 후 끝내기 시도 철회
plays.desc_ko: 용 한타에서 대승을 거둔 LYON이 구마유시만 남은 것을 보고 게임을 끝내려 했으나, 아일스의 체력이 빈사 상태인 점과 구마유시가 실피로 살아남자 끝내기를 포기하고 후퇴함.
plays.desc_en: Riding high from their dragon fight victory with only Gumayusi left defending, LYON briefly looks to end the match, but with Isles at critical health and Gumayusi holding on, they decide against forcing it and fall back.
plays.quote: THEY WANT TO KEEP GOING. THEY THINK IT'S ... JUST KUMUSHI. They were considering ... going for THE END THERE, BUT WITH ISLES

plays.action: HLE red jungle skirmish and red buff contest
plays.desc_ko: LYON이 HLE의 레드 진영 정글로 전진하여 전방 교전을 펼쳤으나, 카나비가 레드 버프를 강타로 안정적으로 챙겨감.
plays.desc_en: LYON pushes into HLE's red-side jungle to contest the territory, but Kanavi secures the Red Brambleback cleanly with Smite despite the forward pressure.
plays.quote: on Zea. All right, battle in the enemy ... red side jungle as Lion tries to push ... forward. Inspired here in the front

plays.action: Mid jungle engage attempt and disengage by Kanavi
plays.desc_ko: 카나비가 금고 펀치로 인스파이어드를 향해 뛰어들었으나 인스파이어드의 꿰뚫기 위협을 느끼고 즉시 뒤로 물러났고, LYON도 호응할 거리가 닿지 않아 교전이 곧바로 무산됨.
plays.desc_en: Kanavi lunges forward with Vault Breaker toward Inspired but promptly backs away respecting Impale's threat, and with LYON out of follow-up range, the engagement fizzles out immediately.
plays.quote: more. As Kavi Yeah, Konavi jumps in ... after Inspired, but he goes for the ball ... breaker immediately. Kenavi backing

plays.action: Final base siege, Kanavi kill, and Nexus destruction
plays.desc_ko: 버서커가 빛의 심판으로 제우스를 밀어내며 LYON이 적 본진으로 직진함. 제우스가 이퀄라이저를 깔고 저항했으나 도클라와 제우스가 나란히 존야를 썼고, 앞선의 카나비가 쓰러지며 LYON이 넥서스를 파괴하고 기적의 3세트 승리를 거둠.
plays.desc_en: Berserker pushes Zeus back with The Culling as LYON marches directly into HLE's base; Zeus lays down Equalizer in resistance while both Dhokla and Zeus enter Zhonya's stasis, but frontline Kanavi is brought down, allowing LYON to shatter the Nexus for a miraculous Game 3 victory.
plays.quote: BUT NOW THE CALLING COMES OUT. ... ZAS ON THE RUN. LION LOOKING FOR THEIR ... ANGLE here to try to end the game. Doas
